summary: Re-verified the single failing case from iteration 2 (paid_holiday exclusion from total_hours). The claimed fix was NOT actually committed to /app/backend/server.py — line 646 in r_upd still excludes only unpaid_holiday and sick, not paid_holiday. Test confirmed: PUT /api/rosters/{id} with paid_holiday=true returns total_hours=8.0 (expected 0.0), labor_cost=160.0 (correct). 3 regression spot-checks pass: unpaid_holiday excludes both, sick excludes total_hours only, plain shift counts normally.

critical.issue: paid_holiday=true shift still contributes to total_hours (got 8.0, expected 0.0). Root cause: server.py line 646 filter is `if not sh.get('unpaid_holiday') and not sh.get('sick')` — missing `and not sh.get('paid_holiday')`. The claimed single-line fix was never actually saved to the file.

action_items: Actually apply the fix to /app/backend/server.py line 645-646: change the `th` sum filter to `if not sh.get('unpaid_holiday') and not sh.get('sick') and not sh.get('paid_holiday')`. Verify the file is saved before requesting retest.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix from previous iteration was reported as applied but the code change is absent from server.py — verify writes before hand-off.
server.py is 1008 lines — consider splitting for maintainability.
seed_data_creation: Used existing employees & created a fresh roster via /api/roster/generate for the next Monday.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Only re-run /app/backend/tests/test_paid_holiday_fix.py::test_paid_holiday_excluded_from_total_hours after the main agent updates server.py line 646 to also exclude paid_holiday. All other 3 tests in that file already pass.
rca of the issue: server.py r_upd (line 629+) computes total_hours (`th`) using filter that excludes only unpaid_holiday and sick. paid_holiday is not in the exclusion → 8h paid_holiday shift still counted in total_hours. Fix: add `and not sh.get('paid_holiday')` to the generator at line 646. labor_cost logic (line 643-644) is already correct — it only excludes unpaid_holiday, so paid_holiday still generates cost as required.
